P1.rule: on every binary view the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003

P2.rule: the seed-mean raw gap is positive on at least 90% of views that carry signal (primary: signal = seed-mean (constant minus CE-trained head) > 0)

P2_strict_signal.rule: the seed-mean raw gap is positive on at least 90% of views that carry signal (stricter: signal also needs the paired interval above 0 on at least 3 of 5 seeds)

P3.rule: for K of 3 or more the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003 on at least 80% of views; refuted if some K >= 3 view has a matched gap above 0.005 with the interval above 0 on at least 3 of 5 seeds (the preregistration says 'whose interval excludes 0' and adds 'while its K = 2 view shows about 0'; the 3-of-5 reading is this script's operationalization and the K = 2 clause is not applied)

P4.rule: raising the iteration cap from 35 to 300 changes no seed-mean matched gap by more than 0.003

P5.rule: in both entropy strata the seed-mean raw gap is positive and the absolute seed-mean matched gap is below 0.003 (literal reading: every view with strata)
